inicio.frasePago: The plan is paid in full at sign-up. If your international card allows installments, the terms are set by your bank, not by drones.orientese.com.
inicio.slide2P1: Farmers, cooperatives, construction firms, companies, schools, pilots, assistants, technicians, engineers and everyone connected to the drone world: we warmly invite you to sign up and use this new informational site, created to serve you in a useful and pleasant way.
inicio.slide2P2: From October through December 2026 you may sign up and use the plan that suits you best, FREE of charge.
inicio.slide3P1: That is it: SIGN UP with THE PLAN THAT SUITS YOU BEST and use it FREE until 31-12-2026, the deadline to switch to another plan and/or ACTIVATE the one you chose for 2027, with all plan benefits included + the guaranteed launch quota for the first 1800 registrations per PLAN, in every country, in the FIRST STAGE (E1).
inicio.slide3P2: When you ACTIVATE the PLAN you chose (deadline 31-12-2026) is when you make the FULL PAYMENT with your approved international credit card, and with the installments you decide to pay your bank.
inicio.slide4P1: The plans to choose from, according to your needs, can be seen in detail under PLANS; you sign up conveniently under SIGN UP.
inicio.slide4P2: They are designed for each user according to what we consider to be the possibilities of daily and monthly use, in line with their activities.
inicio.slide4P3: The price of each one relates to what could be less than the cost of a coffee a day, at a commercial establishment of your choice.
inicio.slide4P4: Benefits relate to what we estimate you may need so you get what you are looking for, directly, with no intermediaries, no commissions and by mutual agreement.
inicio.slide4P5: There can be many possibilities with many opportunities.
inicio.slide5P1: Until 31 December 2026 you may sign up free of charge under SIGN UP and thereby secure a slot in the First Stage launch promotion, for the first 1800 registrations per plan and worldwide total.
inicio.slide5P2: This promotion lasts 60 days, starting 1 January 2027, and may be renewed in a country where it is needed.
inicio.slide5P3: The First Stage launch promotion includes discounts of:
inicio.slide5P4: 10% for PLAN PLUS (Consecuente) - 15% for PLAN PRO (Amigo) and
inicio.slide5P6: In addition to the benefits of each PLAN, which you can see under PLANS.
inicio.slide5P7: SIGN UP NOW and START USING the BENEFITS of the selected PLAN.
